study.question: Can eliminating unused intermediate coefficient calculations lower measured prediction cost at fixed learned capacity and preserve all four predictions, avoiding the auxiliary-quality damage of further private-head reductions?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the recent private-head trajectory preserves click AUC 0.6671669182126774 but parent cart/fav AUCs 0.6769436039495349/0.6737168279059741 are far below the g2-r0038-joint_context_buy_only values 0.786756/0.790103. The readout-scale intervention helps (cart/fav 0.689446/0.675569), while hidden rescaling is negative and both is mixed; no causal value of external method cards follows. Separately, source inspection finds unused normalized coefficient tensors in the frozen ordinal/quadratic/duplicate branch. Their production incurs memory traffic and pointwise kernels but has no path to outputs, gradients, state or RNG. Removing those expressions should preserve the complete learned model and reduce execution cost. This extends the local live-branch specialization in g2-r0027-joint_summary_active; it is an engineering hypothesis, not a new unified-model mechanism or novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived exact-version primary text, lines 250-277, sha256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e. Inherit target-conditioned unnormalized local activation. This experiment changes only unused operations in the local compression extension, not DIN attention or its reported original results.

Resolved receipt and inspected the inherited available/norm _joint_coefficients specialization. Extend the same live-dependency principle to other discarded intermediates, retaining all support norms and predicates; no priority claim.

Complete standalone source is the immediate executable reference. No Parameter reduction, initialization change, capacity reallocation, feedback change or checkpoint reuse. Only temporary tensors with no live consumer are omitted.

inherited_components: All Model initialization, embeddings and source gates from g2-r0045-joint_init_reference
Compressed history and five target-match summaries, every support/degeneracy computation, attached normalization support and all Dice populations
Task-specific residuals/towers and the full inherited evaluation path
Inherited private hidden/readout scaling modes both inherited, despite the latest readout-only gain, to avoid mixing initialization and execution interventions
study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 source-level execution contrast: summary live-output specialization (A), fifth-extension early duplicate return after the full gate (B), and A+B. Reference source/config are byte-identical to g2-r0045-joint_init_reference. Each model is standalone. Learned capacity and information flow are unchanged; only temporary output construction is reduced. Removing support predicates or projection sweeps is explicitly outside this study.
predictions: At a fixed state, deterministic FP32 and frozen BF16 checks should give exact equality of retained coefficients, four finite [B,1] probabilities, loss, input/parameter gradients, Dice buffers, RNG and a frozen-optimizer step. Test train/eval, empty histories, partial and noncontiguous masks, excluded IDs, B=1 and final partial batch. No local numerical execution is available; host must perform these checks before full training.

Freeze prospective screening gates now: click AUC >= contemporaneous reference minus 0.000001 and >= frozen entry 0.666753547526167 minus 0.0002; every auxiliary AUC >= reference minus 0.000001 and every task Logloss <= reference plus 0.000001. Exact equality is expected; passing these narrow practical gates does not establish statistical equivalence. No gate may be relaxed after feedback.
Dense/embedding/total Parameters should remain exactly 204531/31793216/31997747. Mask restrictions, train examples, data passes and all four task losses remain unchanged.

Practical cost success requires at least 2% lower matched model-only p50 and nonincreased p95 batch latency, plus nonincreased full-validation wall time. Record training wall time, allocated GPU seconds and peak memory even if they worsen. Validate cost in at least three interleaved matched timing repeats if the host supports them; otherwise label single-run cost provisional and do not claim reproducible savings.
A and B may produce subadditive savings because unchanged embedding/compression work dominates. Neither parameter savings nor a new predictive mechanism is predicted.
falsifiers: Any retained tensor, gradient, buffer, RNG or optimizer-step discrepancy under deterministic parity checks invalidates the dead-work-only explanation and blocks training. Preserve failures; do not convert them to an AUC result.
A reproducible quality loss, any violation of frozen information/ownership boundaries, or changed Parameter inventory rejects the implementation.
No reproducible measured latency reduction rejects practical efficiency for this implementation, even if source operation count falls.
The previous private-head and embedding/scorer reductions remain distinct negative or mixed trajectories; they do not prove all remaining capacity is necessary.
alternative_explanations: Smaller transient allocations may not change wall time because embedding lookup or loader work dominates.
Runtime contention, thermal state and allocator warmup may explain timing changes. Same-seed reexecutions do not supply independent mechanism support.
BF16 kernel scheduling or hidden state changes could cause a parity failure; source-level dependency checks alone cannot rule these out.

The legacy auxiliary-quality loss is inherited and is not repaired by execution specialization. The task remains an offline benchmark with auxiliary user/category/brand label semantics and possibly immature historical feedback.
